dct:provenance: CIViC's public DataReleases GraphQL query at https://civicdb.org/api/graphql was used on 2026-07-16 to enumerate all 134 advertised release branches (the mutable nightly branch plus 133 historical monthly branches from 01-May-2015 through 01-Jul-2026). All 601 non-null TSV and VCF paths returned by that authoritative query were downloaded successfully and are represented individually in distribution; no advertised branch or file failed. The root is a client-rendered application, so its HTML shell did not itself enumerate release links; the application's same-origin public DataReleases query and its official Data Releases documentation were used for complete traversal. The public GraphQL API was reviewed as an access mechanism but is not modeled as a static downloadable FileObject. No archive files were advertised, so there are no inner archive members. Every downloaded non-empty TSV and VCF yielded a recordSet; the two advertised 01-Feb-2020 VCF files are zero-byte files, so they remain represented in distribution but no schema or recordSet could be supported for them. Exact field names were preserved from each TSV's first non-empty header row or each VCF's #CHROM header line without normalization. Leading VCF ## metadata and any leading TSV comments were treated as preamble; datatype inference sampled no more than five data rows per file and uses Text when the sample did not unambiguously support Boolean, Integer, or Float. VCF is represented as text/plain because the server reports application/octet-stream and no universally registered VCF media type is established by the source. The mutable nightly files may change after this crawl; sha256 and contentSize describe the bytes retrieved during this run. CIViC does not publish datePublished or a single dataset version on the checked pages; those recommended values are omitted rather than invented. The exact access and licensing statements, description, and requested citation are sourced from CIViC's official documentation. No location-oriented columns forming a coherent place model were observed, so no GeoCoordinates hierarchy was added.
